summary: Part 3 of 4 (07:05-11:58) of the "1.0 Onboarding App (KAM)" video covers the admin side of the Revibe Seller Onboarding App (AppSheet), the Google Sheet 'Onboarding Plan' used for outbound recruiting, and the Leads list with the lead call process. The trainer sets the seller record 'Pierre' (email pierre@revibe.me) Approval to Incomplete and picks the missing elements as Rationale, explains the Application status groups in the Profile tab, walks through the Onboarding Plan columns and their if-yes/if-no logic, and shows how to work a lead: call, log the call in the Comment field, and set the Stage to Sent to app or Cancelled. On screen, Final review is still entered in Approval even though the narration says it is no longer chosen. Several pack frame citations were wrong (t00476, t00478, t00480, t00576, t00583, t00600) and have been corrected. All 40 listed frames were opened.

screens.name: Google Sheet 'Seller Onboarding App' tab 'Profile'
screens.shows: Seller master list columns: ID, First name, Last name, Email, Phone, Company name, Country, Emirate, Address for pick ups, Google map location for pick ups, What kind of products you sell, Are you a wholesaler (B2B). Tab bar listed in the fact above.

screens.name: Google Sheet 'Seller Onboarding App' tab 'Onboarding Plan'
screens.shows: Outbound recruiting list. Columns: Batch, Supplier, Owner, Revibe name, Legal name, Marketplace / Source, Country, Location, URL, Email, Phone, Contact name, Rating, Number of Reviews, Customers, Categories, Notes, Contacted, Answer, To visit, Onboarding App, if yes - Stage, if no - Rationale, Priority, Comments & Notes, App Notes, Total. Filter icons on the column headers.

screens.name: PDF 'Sellers journey.pdf' (page 6 of 12)
screens.shows: Four-step journey: 1. Inbound, 2. Outbound, 3. Seller view, 4. Admin view. Onboarding App box: Legal clearance, Revibe terms and conditions, Quality guidelines.

screens.name: Revibe Seller Onboarding App > Leads
screens.shows: Leads grouped by country (Hong Kong 6, Philippines 2, Saudi Arabia 254, South Africa 202, United Arab Emirates 402), then by Units Sold bracket. Columns: Days since last update, First name, Last name, Email, Phone, Country, Business Name, Units Sold, Contact status, Stage, Not completed initially reason.

screens.name: Revibe Seller Onboarding App > Leads > lead side panel and edit form
screens.shows: Lead panel with Edit button; edit form with Email, ID, Contact status, Stage dropdown (Created, Contacted, Sent to app, Cancelled), Not completed initially reason, Comment box with dated entries, and Cancel and Save buttons at the top right.

terms.meaning: The Revibe Seller Onboarding App (appsheet.com) where sellers register and where the admin view tracks them. Screen title reads 'Revibe - Seller Onboarding App'.
Step 1 of the sellers' journey, as listed on the Sellers journey slide.
Step 2 of the sellers' journey: when the team tries to reach out to sellers.
Step 3: the seller's own view of the application (quality guidelines, documents, bank details).
Step 4 of the sellers' journey: the admin view of the app, which the trainer shows from 09:30 and which is used to process seller applications.
Google Sheet tab listing outbound sellers (more than 300 across the UAE per narration), with an Owner (account manager) per seller.
Admin field for the decision on an application (screen shows Final review and Incomplete).
Status of a seller's application, for example Under review, Missing data, Application incomplete.
Admin field listing the missing elements (when Approval is Incomplete) or, on the Onboarding Plan sheet, the if-no reason for a seller not on the onboarding app.
Sellers accepted or rejected at the onboarding app stage.
Sellers whose application is missing data (Approval Incomplete).
Group the trainer describes as the sellers the KAM needs to treat; on screen it includes blank and Final review rows.
Sellers who started onboarding but did not get to the last stage.
Sellers who completed the website form but did not complete anything on the onboarding app.
Lead field showing the call state (To call, Called (1), Answered).
Lead field: Created (initial), Contacted, Sent to app, Cancelled.
Lead stage meaning the lead was sent the onboarding app link (set by clicking the stage).
Lead stage for leads that are not interested after the KAM's attempt to convince them.
Lead column with brackets of units sold claimed by the seller; used to rank leads.
Lead field giving why the form was not completed (example value: Other).
Staff member in charge of recruiting a given seller on the Onboarding Plan (values: Marwan, Yahia, Pepe).
Onboarding Plan column shown as star marks. Its meaning is not explained in the video.
Upload field on the admin side panel for proof when needed.
Admin-only comment field; the trainer says it is written with the date first, then the month, then the message.
Standards for the first shipment to the Revibe warehouse and future shipments sent directly to customers, linked from the seller view.

unclear.issue: The narration says Final review is a stage the KAM no longer chooses, but the screen shows the trainer entering 'Final review' in Approval at 07:05-07:13 (t00428.jpg, t00433.jpg). Do not state Final review as a usable choice without confirmation.
The narration says Approval can be accepted, rejected or incomplete. On screen only Final review and Incomplete appear in Approval during this segment; accepted and rejected are not shown.
Narration says the onboarding plan lists more than 300 sellers across the UAE, but the Onboarding Plan rows show Country values KSA as well as UAE (t00480.jpg, t00488.jpg). Scope unclear.
'{CAMS?} can also buy their own decide to go on {noon?} or amazon' is not clear; the role name is probably KAMs but this is not confirmed, and nothing on screen supports 'buy their own'.
Narration says 'monthly sales they pretend to have', but the column is labelled 'Units Sold'. The wording (monthly vs units) cannot be confirmed.
Two Units Sold brackets look alike on screen: '10 000+' (11) and '+10 000' (7). Whether they are the same bracket is unclear.

The internal comment format 'date then the month then the message' is not shown as an example on the admin panel. The dated format on screen (11/11 - ...) is from the lead Comment field, so applying it to internal comments is not confirmed.
'every time you make a call you need to mention it' does not say which field to use. The screen shows the lead Comment field with dated entries, but the narration does not name it.

Narration says the Profile holds all sellers who are registering; the Application incomplete and Under review rows show different Approval values. How the Application status values are set automatically is not explained.
Narration gives 'already a seller' and 'has been rejected' as examples for the if-no reason, but the mapping to Already seller / Rejected is inferred from the dropdown values.
The Rationale field is multi-select with checkboxes, but the video does not say whether every missing element must be selected.

Narration names the lead 'Marwan Ahmed', but the lead record on screen shows first name 'ahmed' with no last name (t00678.jpg, t00701.jpg). 'Marwan' appears on screen only in 'Updated by marwan.ahmed@revibe.me' (t00678.jpg). The name in the narration cannot be confirmed as the lead's.

outdated.signal: Narration says Final review is 'a stage that we don't choose anymore', so the Approval step described at 07:05-07:13 is outdated for KAMs.
Example lead record shows 'Days since last update 331' and 'Created at 11/2/2025' (t00678.jpg), and comment dates run from 03/11 to 11/11; this is old example data, not current status.

Sidebar counts (Application closed 346, Missing data 52, Under review 25, Application incomplete 3) and Leads counts (UAE 402, Saudi Arabia 254, South Africa 202) are a snapshot from the recording and will change.

privacy.what: Seller and staff data visible: the 'Pierre' record shows the email pierre@revibe.me, a phone number, company PEPE trading LLC and document filenames (for example 02f28922.Emirates ID.114645.html). The Profile list behind the panel (t00425) shows many sellers' names, company names, emails and phone numbers.

Onboarding Plan shows supplier contact names (for example Zahid, Liu, Dasun), emails, phone numbers, business URLs, and Legal name and Location columns. The Profile tab (t00478) shows Address for pick ups and Google map locations.
Profile list shows many sellers' full names, company names, email addresses and phone numbers, including sellers in Missing data and Application incomplete.
Leads list shows lead names, email addresses, phone numbers and business names, including real leads with contact status and stage.

A lead record shows a named person's email, phone number, business name and a trade license link, plus the comment history with supplier details. The 'Updated by' field shows the staff email marwan.ahmed@revibe.me.

Two lead records under Pierre Villaceque: business 'Revibe' (email iam.pepemanagement) and business 'Revibe TEST' (email pierre.villaceque@gmail.com, phone 966544637092). These look internal or test, but the Gmail address and phone number are personal-looking data.
